description:
Priority: P2 | Area: area:plugin | Labels: fix,P2,area:plugin | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: - | Task: CTX-0009

Issue: https://github.com/bitty-terminal/file-manager/issues/37

`open` mounts a non-focusable bottom band block and no command hides it: Esc never reaches a
non-focusable band, the host chrome has no affordance for a mounted block, and Plugin API v1 has
no ui.unmount (bitty#3106).

Add `close`: ui.update the existing handle with a row-less Column+empty Text, clear the cached
listing, keep the handle for reuse, idempotent (changed=false, no host call when nothing is
mounted). Version 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1.

Scopes: lua/file-manager/init.lua, lua/file-manager/scene.lua, bitty-plugin.toml, tests/spec/init_spec.lua,
validator-negative/base.toml, README.md, CHANGELOG.md. No capability change.
title: file-manager: add a close command so the mounted listing can be dismissed

description:
Priority: P1 | Area: area:plugin | Labels: fix,P1,area:plugin | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: - | Task: CTX-0010

Follow-up from the independent review of CTX-0009 (PR #38, released as 0.1.1). Findings:

1. MAJOR: close_listing cleared view.root/entries/selected/error. close is presentation-only, so the
   next preview (or open with no args) then reported an empty listing. Reviewer reproduced
   `preview after close: ok=true renders="Empty directory|"` - the plugin lied about the directory.
2. MAJOR: documented idempotence did not hold. changed was derived from view.handle ~= nil and the
   handle is kept after a close, so a second close returned changed=true and issued another
   bitty.ui.update (verified: first changed=true updates=1 | second changed=true updates=2).

Fix: track view.visible separately from view.handle. close hides the block and clears only visible;
it keeps root/entries/selected/error so a later open/preview continues from the same listing;
mount_component sets visible=true on a successful mount or update; close with visible=false returns
changed=false and issues no host call.

Scopes: lua/file-manager/init.lua, tests/spec/init_spec.lua, README.md, CHANGELOG.md,
bitty-plugin.toml (0.1.1 -> 0.1.2), validator-negative/base.toml. No capability change.
title: file-manager: make close presentation-only and actually idempotent

description:
Priority: P2 | Area: area:plugin | Labels: fix,P2,area:plugin | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: - | Task: CTX-0011

Remaining findings from the independent review of PR #38/#40:

1. minor: close was registered as `return close_listing()`, a table return, and command dispatch raises a
   banner for tables (README documents that open returns true precisely to avoid it). A chord bound to
   close therefore popped {changed=true, handle=n} on every press. The command now calls close_listing()
   and returns true; M.close_listing() keeps the state table for programmatic callers and tests.
2. minor: on ui.update returning false (stale handle) close raised E_UI_UNAVAILABLE and kept the handle,
   which wedges: the v1 contract says false means the handle is stale, i.e. the block is already gone.
   close now nulls the handle and finishes the dismissal, mirroring mount_component's self-heal.
3. nit: bitty-plugin.toml / validator-negative/base.toml comment claimed 'All three commands ... unchanged'.
4. nit: scene.hidden comment claimed the same node shape as devtools (devtools uses a bare Text).
5. nit: package.json carried version 0.1.0.

Version 0.1.2 -> 0.1.3 in bitty-plugin.toml and package.json. No capability change.
Canonical doc sync for the lazy command lists stays with bitty-plugins-docs (separate repo/task).
title: file-manager: close returns boolean, self-heals a stale handle, and clears doc drift
